content: Logidiina mayawasina
Eeta ꞌimi galao ma ꞌimi ꞌeꞌaboꞌabowao gwaeyega bo paihowega ma ꞌimi heꞌipiꞌipiyao ma ꞌimi ꞌahwa galagalao waguipailedi,
ma hesi yaluyaluwami ꞌana susu bwebweꞌana waꞌebese, gidemusa taudi gwagwama hauhaudi susu nuwanuwadi, eeta susuina yaluyaluwami ꞌadi ꞌabihetena weyahina.
Comi ꞌida Badaina ꞌina ꞌatemuyamuya walotoho pwaiya,
ꞌoinega wanaoma ꞌoina, tauna logidi mayawasina, mebaleꞌu silososomaneya, ma hesi Yehoba nuwanuwana eeta ꞌihesinuweya.

Coinega ꞌomi wete gide yowayowana mayawasina, yaluyaluwami watagwaledi, ma ꞌoimiyega Yehoba ꞌina Hada ꞌida ꞌabi, ma nage ꞌoina wahetopwaoli ꞌehaumi, ma Yesu Keliso ꞌilemegomi ma yaluyaluwamiyega wahetopwaoli bwebweꞌana Yehoba ꞌoina.
Gidemusa wete Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌoina ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Waꞌita logidi bewa bwebweꞌana ma hesihesinuwaina yalagulagu nugete hada ꞌana ꞌabi weyahina ꞌasa Saiyoni ꞌoina. Ceguma taiyawedi sihemisa tauna ꞌoina geyaꞌabwa sideba mwadina.”

content: Ma ꞌomi taiyawedi logidi bewa wahemisaeya, tauna ꞌoimiya ꞌabehega logidi bwebweꞌana hedade, ma hesi taudi geya ꞌoina sihemisae taudi weyahidi Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌoina ꞌihepwaileya, ꞌigwae,

content.text: “Logidiina mwalo toꞌabi hada silogwahateya, ma bewa tuwa sihetoholo pwaiya ma ꞌihelogidi nugeta, ma logidi mabwaiyadi ꞌiloinaedi.”

content: Ma wete ꞌigwae,

content.text: “Logidi bewa tomota ꞌidi ꞌebetupa, ꞌabwa ꞌoina situpa ma sibeꞌu.”

content: Ma situpa ꞌoina weyahina gwae geya sihemisae. Bewa gide Yehobaina ꞌina loina nugenugetana taudi weyahidi.

Ma ꞌomi geya gide taudi, ma ꞌomi hesi Yehoba ꞌina boda hesihesinuwaimi, ꞌomi Kiniina ꞌina topwaoli ma ꞌina tomotaiyao ꞌehaumi, weyahina tupwa guguyou ꞌoinega ꞌibwauwegomiya eeta ꞌina ꞌasilala tobwebweꞌana hedada ꞌoina ꞌilagugomiya, ma ꞌabehega ꞌina paihowa bwebweꞌanaina wahepwaile.
Tuta mwalo ꞌoidiya ꞌomi geya waheboda ꞌaigeda, ma sauga bewa Yehoba ꞌoina waheboda ꞌaigeda pwaiya, ma mwalo wete Yehoba ꞌina ꞌatemuyamuya geya ꞌoimiya ꞌimiyamiya, ma sauga bewa waloba pwaiya.
Yehoba ꞌina topaihowao
Ciyagwao ꞌoimiya yahepwaila ꞌabehega tauda baleꞌu bewa ꞌoina tohetautaumana, ꞌoinega ꞌimi nuwaꞌubunaowedi ꞌatemiya simiyamiya walogwahatedi, weyahina yaluyaluwami siloꞌalehedi.

Ma wamumuga bwebweꞌana taudi geya meYudiya ꞌoidiya. Weyahina bewa tuwa ꞌabwa siꞌahwaꞌahwa galagalaegomi, ma tuta muliyetega ꞌimi paihowa bwebweꞌana siꞌita, ma ꞌoinega tutaina Yehoba ꞌilatuma Yehobaina sihepwatuwe.
Comi Badaina ꞌina boda, ꞌoinega ꞌilobwainegomiya ma loina mabwaiyana baleꞌuwa waheꞌasisiyanedi, gidemusa kini ꞌina loina ꞌoina watagwalegomi, weyahina tauna toloina madouna,
ma wete gabemaniyao waheꞌasisiyanedi, weyahina kiniina ꞌihesinuwediya ma gabemaniyedi togala siloinaedi, ma tobwebweꞌana siꞌahwa bwebweꞌanedi.
Ma Yehoba ꞌina nuwatuhu bewa ma ꞌeguma tomataꞌuꞌupao sigwae besobeso weyahimi, ma ꞌiyamo ꞌimi paihowa bwebweꞌana ꞌabwa siꞌita ma gesowana toꞌaha weyahimi sigwaegwae.
Ma ꞌomi hesi Yehoba ꞌilihasi pwaigomiya ma ꞌabehega waboi waloinaegomi, ma hesi geyaꞌabwa paihowa galadi ꞌoidiya watautauya, ma wapaihowa tuwa gidemusa ꞌomi Yehoba ꞌina topaihowao.
Coinega tomota mabwaiyadi waheꞌasisiyanedi, ma taudi Yesu ꞌana tohemisao wahelauwedi. Yehoba ꞌoina waheꞌasisi madouna, ma wete toloinaina kini waheꞌasisiyane.
Keliso weyahida ꞌiꞌehuyala
Ma ꞌomi topaihowao ꞌimi babadao waheꞌasisiyanedi ma ꞌoidiya wahematamatana, ma geya ꞌabehega babadao bwebweꞌadimo ꞌoidiya, ma wete taudi ꞌidi loina waiwaidi wete waheꞌasisiyanedi.
Weyahina ꞌeguma geya ꞌaigeda ꞌimi paihowa galana, ma sigihemuya daisigomi ma Yehoba weyahina wanuwanuwatuhu madouna eeta waꞌalamaꞌiꞌitana, beno mumuga bwebweꞌana Yehoba matana.

Ma wanuwatuhuyahi ꞌabehega ꞌeguma ꞌida paihowa galana ꞌoinega sigihemuyegita ma taꞌalamaꞌiꞌita, beno geya ginaula madouna. Ma hesi ꞌeguma ꞌida paihowa bwebweꞌana ꞌoinega sigihemuyegita, ma taꞌalamaꞌiꞌitana, Yehoba weyahida ꞌiyaliyaya.
Ma ꞌeda bewa weyahina Yehoba ꞌibwau pwaigita, weyahina Keliso tauna weyahida ꞌiꞌemuyamuya eeta ꞌebeꞌita ꞌilaguya ꞌoida ma ꞌabehega leleyana tamuliyedi.
Weyahina tauna geya ꞌina galamo ma wete geya ꞌeta ꞌabo ꞌahwanega ꞌida latuwa.
Ma tutaina siꞌahwa galagalaeya geya wete ꞌoidiya ꞌiheꞌisa, ma wete siꞌehemuyeya, geya wete ꞌigamwasowaledi, ma hesi Yehoba ꞌihemiseya moisa, weyahina tauna Toloina dumwadumwaluna.

Ma weteyage Keliso tauna wahinega ꞌida galao ꞌiꞌahalidiya kelose ꞌoina, ma nage ꞌoinega ꞌida mumuga galadi sigumwala, ma mumuga dumwaluna ꞌoinega tatauya. Tauna ꞌana badi ꞌoinega ꞌimi bwebweꞌana walobeya.
Moisa, ꞌomi gide sipi hehebeꞌuina, eeta sipi ꞌadi toꞌitayahina ꞌitoe hilegomima ꞌoina, tauna yaluyaluwami ꞌana toꞌitayahina.
